title: Align compact change briefs with customer-impact mapping and rapid signoff
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: create a tightly-scoped process and template for 'compact change briefs' — one-paragraph + one-line exec summary + impact mapping per customer tier — that accelerates release-note drafting and reduces cross-team iteration. This ticket will produce the template, automation checklist, and a first-pass batch of compact briefs for the 2026.02 console release.

Background: Current release-note cycles are too verbose for engineers and too technical for account teams. We get repeated review loops with Eng/Design/Legal for each changelog item. The compact brief is intended to live alongside the canonical changelog: it will be the primary artifact used in customer emails, CSM handoffs, and the internal launch digest.

Scope: (1) Design short template and signoff matrix; (2) Build a redaction checklist and automated tag extraction guidance for PR authors; (3) Draft compact briefs for 8 major changes in console-2026.02; (4) Run a 48-hour review window with Eng, Design, Legal, and CSM and resolve comments.

Out of scope: full product PRD updates, multi-language localization (will be a follow-up), and gated enterprise communication cadence (handled by PM-33109).
acceptance_criteria: A templated compact change brief (one-paragraph + one-line exec summary + 3-tier customer impact mapping) approved by Eng, Design, Legal, and CSM
Automated checklist in the draft doc that maps PR labels to brief fields and flags PII/security-sensitive language
Eight finalized compact briefs for console-2026.02 merged into the release docs and linked from the public changelog draft
Stakeholder signoff recorded in the signoff matrix and release-ready flag set in the launch tracker
